As a frontend engineer, I bring a strong foundation in full-stack systems and scalable architecture, developed through six years as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, where I owned the order-routing service using TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL, handling approximately 2 million events per day. My experience extends to designing and optimizing database systems, including schema design, query tuning, and logical replication in PostgreSQL, ensuring high performance and reliability under heavy load. I have also led teams as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, managing cross-functional product lines and driving technical strategy across dispatch and billing systems.

I have successfully executed large-scale system transformations, including a nine-month Strangler-fig migration from a monolith to event-driven services with zero customer-visible downtime. This initiative reduced p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds, demonstrating my ability to deliver measurable performance improvements while maintaining system stability. My work has consistently emphasized resilience, observability, and incremental change—principles that directly apply to building robust, user-centric frontend experiences.

I am proficient in modern infrastructure tools, including Kubernetes and Terraform, which I have used to deploy and manage services at scale. While my primary experience has been in backend and systems engineering, I am deeply familiar with the full software lifecycle and am committed to building high-quality, performant frontend applications that align with scalable, maintainable architectures. I am eager to apply my technical depth and leadership experience to contribute to Windrose Travel’s mission of delivering seamless travel experiences through technology.
